sentences.text: Vs. Smt. Madhumita Sarkar & Anr. Mr. Manoranjan Mahata ... for the State
The present revision is of the year 2019 relating to Baguiati Police Station Case No.14/18 dated 12.01.2018 under Section 498A/323/406/506/34 of the IPC.
Mr. Monoranjan Mahata, learned counsel for the State present in court is appointed to represent the State in this case.
None appears for the the petitioners in spite of repeated calls since the date of listing, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected application stands disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance.
Learned counsel for the State to inform the status of this case to the concerned authority.
